_source: Puppet Master. One-click MCP entries for the sandbox MCP hub. Plain entries use the npm bin names installed by the base recipe's mcp-tools step. Entries with "connector": true are services that need the person's token: each is installed once on connect into /home/pm/.connectors (not part of the image), from a pinned version found in the maker's own docs (see "docs").

entries.name: filesystem
entries.title: Files
entries.description: Read and write files under the sandbox home folder.

entries.name: memory
entries.title: Memory
entries.description: A small key-value memory the bot can keep between chats.

entries.name: playwright
entries.title: Browser (Playwright)
entries.description: Drive the sandbox Chrome with Playwright.

entries.name: github
entries.title: GitHub
entries.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests and code search, through GitHub's own MCP server (MIT licence, run on the bot's computer). Needs a personal access token.

env.label: Personal access token
env.help: Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/tokens with only the repositories and rights you want the bot to have.

entries.name: notion
entries.title: Notion
entries.description: Search and edit pages and databases, through Notion's own MCP server package. Notion says that package is no longer actively maintained and points to its hosted server, so treat it as best effort. Needs an integration token.

env.label: Integration token
env.help: Create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations, copy its secret, then share the pages you want the bot to see with that integration.
